golden_rule: Symbols never fully explain themselves. They respond to perception.

symbols.name: The Delayed Shadow
symbols.lumi_note: It's repeating. The interval is consistent.
symbols.nela_note: Don't write it yet. Something else is coming.

symbols.name: The Incomplete Circle
symbols.lumi_note: The gap rotates by 15 degrees each observation.
symbols.nela_note: It's waiting for the right moment to close.

symbols.name: The Reflected Word
symbols.lumi_note: The reflection shows a different language.
symbols.nela_note: Read it when you're not trying to.
